mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_comment (product_id, member_id, member_nick_name, member_icon, product_name, star, member_ip, create_time, show_status, product_attribute, collect_couont, read_count, content, pics, replay_count) VALUES (#{productId}, #{memberId}, #{memberNickName}, #{memberIcon}, #{productName}, #{star}, #{memberIp}, #{createTime}, #{showStatus}, #{productAttribute}, #{collectCouont}, #{readCount}, #{content}, #{pics}, #{replayCount})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pms_comment WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN star >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_count, SUM(CASE WHEN star = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star5, SUM(CASE WHEN star = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star4, SUM(CASE WHEN star = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star3, SUM(CASE WHEN star = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star2, SUM(CASE WHEN star = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star1 FROM pms_comment WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND show_status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pms_comment SET read_count = IFNULL(read_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE pms_comment SET collect_couont = IFNULL(collect_couont, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
